title: Existence of strong initial traces for stochastic conservation laws
summary: We prove existence and uniqueness of a strong initial trace for every bounded kinetic solution of a stochastic scalar conservation law, although no initial value is prescribed and no nondegeneracy condition is imposed on the flux. The core of the proof is pathwise. After fixing a realization, the rescaled stochastic terms and kinetic measure vanish in the blow-up limit, so Panov's compactness argument applies; degenerate flux intervals are handled by recursive dimension reduction.
